name: [🍨CH2] Eat THE Ice Cream
desc:
🎄 CHAPTER 2 IS HERE! 🎄
The Evil Penguin King hid in his bunker under a NEW mountain of ice cream. Eat it ALL to open the hatch!

🛷 Crash into the King's base on Santa's sleigh
🐧 3 secret traders: new tools, warm clothes & explosives
🎆 Rockets, popcorn bombs & a giant candy cannon
📸 Side quests, new achievements & penguin skins

a cozy game about eating a giant mountain of ice cream to find your lost house keys... 🍦

🔑 Find the Key in a Mountain of Ice Cream!

🍦 Eat through the Ice Cream Mountain
🥄 Upgrade your spoon all the way to a mega vacuum
🍬 Dig up hidden sweets to get stronger
🧊 Don't get Brain Freeze!
🏠 Find the Key and unlock your Home
🏆 Beat your fastest run

Can you make it home?

Tags: Find The Key, Eat the Ice Cream, Eat THE Ice Cream, Ice Cream, Eat, Dig, Snow, Winter, Escape, Home, Story, Adventure, Key, Search, Needle in a Haystack, Peel a Potato, Clean all the Leaves, Brain Freeze, Sweets, Candy, Spoon, Chapter 2, Penguin

llm.loop: eat through a mountain of ice cream -> dig up sweets to get stronger -> upgrade spoon toward a mega vacuum -> find the key and unlock your home -> beat your fastest run
llm.objectives: find the key in the ice cream mountain; in chapter 2 eat it all to open the Evil Penguin King's hatch
llm.progression: spoon/tool upgrades, sweets for strength, chapters, achievements, fastest run
llm.instructions: eat through the ice cream mountain, upgrade your spoon, dig up sweets, avoid brain freeze, find the key and get home
unique: needle-in-a-haystack key hunt inside an edible ice cream mountain with a story chapter
monetization_signals: permanent tool passes (rocket launcher, hair dryer, cannon)
llm.thumbnails: first-person spoon digging a giant neapolitan ice cream mountain, golden key with '0.001%' text and Grab prompt
llm.complexity_notes: voxel-style diggable terrain, tool upgrades, small story chapter
